description: This file contains utility functions for task management in the Superset project, including executor selection, CSRF token fetching, deduplication key generation, and task property handling.

methods.name: get_executor
methods.description: Determines the user and executor type for running a scheduled task based on provided executors and model.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: Retrieves the current username from Flask's global context if available and not anonymous.

methods.name: fetch_csrf_token
methods.description: Fetches a CSRF token and session cookie for API requests.

methods.name: generate_random_task_key
methods.description: Generates a new UUID string to be used as a unique task key.

methods.name: get_active_dedup_key
methods.description: Creates a hashed deduplication key for active tasks based on scope, task type, task key, and user ID.

methods.name: get_finished_dedup_key
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a task UUID for deduplication after task completion.

methods.name: progress_update
methods.description: Creates a TaskProperties dict to update task progress, supporting float, int, and tuple inputs.

methods.name: error_update
methods.description: Creates a TaskProperties dict with error details from an exception.

methods.name: parse_properties
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a TaskProperties dict, returning empty dict on errors.

methods.name: serialize_properties
methods.description: Serializes a TaskProperties dict into a JSON string.
